quote: D2. The cutoff scale Λ is absorbed into the coupling. Severity: substantive. The paper carries `1/Λ_Psi_q`, `1/Λ³_Psi_qB` and `1/Λ²_Phi_q` as separate, explicit factors... The file has no `Λ`. It has one coefficient per operator and enters it as the plain number `0.1`, with no unit attached.
other_list: D4. Normalisation of the triplet epsilon object inside the colour tensor: the reconstruction only says the file's K3bar is "proportional to" ε_ijk instead of confirming the paper's footnote √2·L̄_ijk = ε_ijk, a possible missing factor of two in every rate.
note: The reviewer correctly isolates the missing 1/Lambda suppression as the single largest, rate-changing issue and tells a physicist to settle it first, so the overall assessment points to the right place.
